[[Duck Hunt Event|Duck Hunt]] |first_wave_appearance = 13 ([[Duck Hunt Event|Duck Hunt]]) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]80Beyond wave 20, '''Explosive Ducky''' scaled its health with time. |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Health]]Slightly Fast (5) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Domestic Terrorism}}''' - Upon death, the '''Explosive Ducky''' explodes and stuns any tower caught in the blast, and damages units. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Explosive Ducky''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[D00M's Revenge]] as part of the [[Duck Hunt Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned again in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had high health and a slightly fast speed. When killed, it explodes and stuns nearby towers. Beyond Wave 20, its health would increase over time. ==Appearance== The '''Explosive Ducky''' is a yellow duck with black eyes and an orange beak and feet. It has two C4s strapped on its body, which will explode when the '''Explosive Ducky''' is killed. It also has a red forcefield as a cosmetic. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[D00M's Revenge]] is listed instead. *Towers with long range like the [[Ranger]] can deal with '''Explosive Duckies''' before they get too close and stun your towers. *Towers like the [[Pursuit]] and [[Ranger]] are unable to be stunned by the '''Explosive Ducky''', making them good options. *The [[Medic]] can be used to cleanse any towers stunned by the '''Explosive Ducky'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseExplosiveDuckyExplosion.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, explosion radius variant (16 April 2025 – Present) CorpseLegacyExplosiveDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, no explosion radius variant (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} DuckHuntEvent.png|'''Explosive Ducky''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} DuckHuntPI.png|'''Explosive Ducky''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyExplosiveDuckyIconIG.png|'''Explosive Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon.
